title: Three GE Vernova 6B Gas Turbines Arrive at Project Matador
summary: Three GE Vernova 6B gas turbines have arrived at Project Matador in Carson County, Texas, marking another significant milestone in Fermi America’s development
body_markdown:
Three GE Vernova 6B gas turbines have arrived at Project Matador in Carson County, Texas, marking another significant milestone in Fermi America’s development of large-scale power generation infrastructure.


Following final painting and preparation, the turbines were transported across hundreds of miles of highway to the Project Matador site in the Texas Panhandle. Their arrival represents continued progress in assembling the critical equipment needed to support Fermi America’s planned 17-gigawatt private-grid energy and AI campus.


### **Turning an Industry Challenge Into a Competitive Advantage**


As artificial intelligence drives unprecedented demand for electricity, access to power generation equipment has emerged as a critical constraint on the industry’s ability to expand. Extended manufacturing lead times, growing demand for turbines, and competition for available generation capacity are creating challenges for developers seeking to bring new AI infrastructure online.


For Fermi America, that industry-wide challenge represents a competitive advantage.


The three GE Vernova 6B gas turbines join a broader portfolio of owned power generation assets secured for Project Matador. By acquiring critical equipment and advancing infrastructure development, Fermi America is positioning itself to address one of the most significant challenges facing AI growth: access to reliable, scalable power.


### **From Equipment Deliveries to Energy Infrastructure**


The arrival of these turbines is part of a larger effort to transform Project Matador from a development plan into physical infrastructure. Each major equipment delivery adds to the growing inventory of assets supporting the project’s planned power generation capabilities.


With a long-term vision to develop up to 17 gigawatts of private-grid power capacity, Project Matador is designed to bring energy generation and AI infrastructure together at an unprecedented scale.


While much of the AI industry is focused on securing access to power, Fermi America is focused on building the infrastructure to generate it.


**This is where AI gets power.**
